summary: Full end-to-end verification of the 3 requested feature areas: (1) Voodoo doll logo renders correctly in all 3 locations (Home top-left, Login brand area, Sidebar). (2) Admin Monitoring: CSV export downloads a valid file (2.3KB, 22 rows, header 'timestamp,user_id,name,email,action,meta'); per-user drilldown for Alice returns 4 log rows via /admin/users/{id}/activity. (3) Two-user real-time communication PASSES: Alice created workspace TEST_WS_A28579, invited bob@stitches.app; Bob logged in on a fresh session, saw notif-badge=2 with 'Added to a workspace' notifications, opened TEST_WS_A28579 in Messages and saw Alice's message 'Hello Bob TEST_28586'; Bob sent 'Reply from Bob TEST_28707'; Alice re-logged in and saw Bob's reply in the same channel. Regression: all 6 admin tabs (overview/users/features/seo/monitoring/heatmap) switch, feature flags panel loads. Admin login works. No functional issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Messages.jsx MembersModal has no explicit backdrop-close guard against the underlying send-message form. During testing, a stray click at the wrong z-index dismissed the modal; the modal correctly stops propagation but consider closing on Escape as well for better UX (currently only backdrop click + X button close it).

NotificationBell dropdown backdrop (div.fixed inset-0 z-40 at NotificationBell.jsx:57) intercepts pointer events on the sidebar nav after the bell auto-opens; requires clicking away first. Minor UX / accessibility improvement: mark backdrop as pointer-events-none for the sidebar region, or close on route change.
server.py still ~1000+ lines monolith (called out in iteration_2); recommend splitting into routers.
Real-time uses WS + 5s polling fallback — works, but polling every 5s while a channel is active is wasteful when WS is already open; consider gating the interval on ws.readyState !== OPEN.

success_rate.backend: 100% (CSV + drilldown + invite + messaging all verified via UI-driven API calls)

test_credentials: admin@stitches.app/Admin@123, alice@stitches.app/Alice@123, bob@stitches.app/Bob@123 — all working; passwords unchanged.
seed_data_creation: Created two test workspaces during this run: 'TEST_WS_28450' (Alice, no messages posted — first attempt failed due to test-script modal overlay, later resolved) and 'TEST_WS_A28579' (Alice, contains Alice's + Bob's real-time exchange). Bob was invited to both as a member. No feature flag or admin user modifications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 logos verified: img loads from /logo.png (naturalWidth=1254, HTTP 200, ~1.3MB). Locations: [data-testid=home-brand] img on Home, img[alt='Stitches'] inside neu-raised on Login (both lg and mobile), and img inside aside[data-testid='sidebar']. Admin monitoring CSV header is 'timestamp,user_id,name,email,action,meta'. Two-user flow works via WebSocket ws/{channel_id}?token= plus 5s polling fallback. Invite creates a notification 'Added to a workspace' visible in the notif-badge and dropdown for the invitee. To retest, use TEST_WS_A28579 (already has messages) or create a fresh TEST_WS_* — remember to CLOSE the MembersModal (click backdrop at (50,50) or the X icon) before sending a chat message, otherwise the send-btn force-click hits the modal backdrop and just closes it.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. One test-script issue encountered: MembersModal backdrop intercepted the send-message-btn click when we didn't close the modal before typing/sending; resolved by clicking outside the modal first. This is a test-scripting concern, not a product bug.
